# camundacluster_group (Resource)

A Camunda cluster group

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "camundacluster_group" "example" {
  group_id    = "operators"
  name        = "Operators"
  description = "Group for cluster operators"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The unique ID of the group.
- `name` (String) The display name of the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of a group (the group ID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import camundacluster_group.example "operators"
```
